causal_problem.background: Schwarzschild domain of outer communications, restricted to the gauge-invariant axial ell=2 spin-two sector
causal_problem.existence_reason: P_m is a normally hyperbolic operator with a smooth zeroth-order m*A perturbation; the axial constraints are preserved by the reduced parent equations
causal_problem.retarded_operator: G_m^ret with support in J^+(support F)
causal_problem.scope: mode-reduced TT causal Green operator, not a full metric BV propagator or unrestricted matter coupling
causal_problem.second_order_family: P_m=E+m*A on the transverse-traceless parent sector; after axial separation its principal part is partial_t^2-partial_x^2
causal_problem.source_space: smooth compactly supported axial TT sources

does_not_establish: a full off-shell metric BV retarded propagator
nonzero excitation by a real causal temporally compact physical source
bounded Bondi reconstruction of the complete causal generalized component
a global inverse-Laplace contour deformation across the QNM
threshold, branch-cut, high-frequency or non-pole remainder control
a complete retarded QNM expansion or global t*exp(i*omega_n*t) ringdown term
time-domain stability, detector sensitivity or a quantum statement

laplace_bridge.cutoff_transfer: chi_o Laplace(G_hh,W^ret) chi_s equals the physical outgoing radial transfer in the initial half-plane
laplace_bridge.endpoint_selection: in the lower half-plane the L2 radial solution is horizon-ingoing and infinity-outgoing
laplace_bridge.initial_half_plane: Im(omega)<-c, below the energy growth bound
laplace_bridge.uniqueness: equality on the initial half-plane fixes the unique meromorphic continuation

mass_derivative_identity.causal_support: composition of two retarded kernels remains retarded
mass_derivative_identity.parameter_differentiability: Duhamel/resolvent differentiation for a smooth bounded zeroth-order perturbation on every finite causal slab

meromorphic_continuation.continuation_mechanism: the fixed-domain global ECS pencil and the complete parameter-analytic massive Jost family
meromorphic_continuation.interpretation: the certified double pole is a resonance pole of the meromorphic continuation of an actual causal retarded compact-source/compact-observation transfer operator
